text_block_list.text:
The day of the Mile Championship. Just as 
I was about to send Nishino Flower off as 
usual—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Yay! You ready to rock, whoo☆

Arriving with a racket is Daitaku Helios. 
A senior who debuted before Nishino 
Flower, she is one of today's heavy 
favorites.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Helios-san. Looking forward to 
working with you!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Isn't today totally wild! Aren't we 
overly excited!? So like, let's breeze 
through the paddock and tear up the race, 
ya know?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
And that's why I'm rounding up paddock 
members! TanFla, c'mon over☆

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: —Alright! Let's do call and response☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "Hype up, yoicho! Hype up, yoicho!"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: "Hype up, yoicho. Hype up, yoicho."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: "Hype up, yoicho~. Hype up, yoicho~."

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Who will the goddess of victory smooch 
today?! Which party animal's it gonna 
be?!"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, you were waiting on ME?! Wait, what 
even is a party person?!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
You won't? The Goddess won't give Nature a 
kissy-poo!?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Party animals reign supreme in the mile, 
am I right?! Only true party beasts get 
the W☆

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: I-Is that so...!? ...U-Um.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Did you just say... crunchy?!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Beep! ...Perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, isn't that just honest and cute? 
Honestly, it's pretty soothing.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for not flatlining on us☆ Nature's 
clocked out too, so let's wrap this up!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Party people, ayyy! Nice to meetcha~☆

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: N-Nice to meetcha~!

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe, this is fun.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
In every race, Ms. Helios makes us feel a 
blazing, sun-soaked wind.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Zephyr-san!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text:
"Your run in the Sprinters Stakes is still 
fresh in my memory, but... let us see how 
the wind blows across a mile."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Ye—... ah!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes. Yolo-yolo~ to you too.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Auuugh... P-Please!
